# Brand images

`readme.svg`, `readme-dark.svg`, `social.svg` and `og.svg` are the sources for the README hero pair (`readme.png` light, `readme-dark.png` dark, 2560x1280), the GitHub social preview (`social.png`, 1280x640) and the docs Open Graph image (`docs/public/og-image.jpg`, 1200x630), as listed in `brand.config.json`. Render with `npm run brand:images` (`node .github/brand/render.mjs`); `npm run brand:images:check` (`--check`) re-renders in memory and exits 1 if any source or output is stale. The fonts are Catamaran, Cabin and Roboto Mono under the SIL OFL 1.1 (license texts in `fonts/`), vendored with `render.mjs`, `embed-fonts.mjs` and `tokens.json` from the marcopontili.com repo-brand kit; do not edit the kit files here. The social preview is uploaded manually in GitHub Settings > Social preview from `social.png`.
